content: Mixi ɲaaxi nun mixi fanyi masundi

content.text: I naxa kɔntɔfili mixi ɲaaxie ra.
I naxa tin lude alɔ e tan.
E lisima nɛ mafuren alɔ ɲooge,
e faxama nɛ alɔ sansie.
I xa i taxu Alatala ra, i xa fe fanyi rabatu.
I xa lu yi bɔxi ma, nɔndi xa findi i xa baloe ra.
Alatala xa findi i waxɔnfe ra.
Na kui a i waxɔnfe ragirima nɛ.
I i xaxili ti Alatala ra, a birin taxu a ra.
A tan nan fe ragirima.
Ala fama i xa nɔndi makɛnɛnde
alɔ a soge raminima ki naxɛ gɛɛsɛgɛ.
A i xa xunnakeli makɛnɛnma
alɔ soge naxan yanbama yanyi ra.
I bɔɲɛ raxara Alatala ya i,
i xa mamɛ ti, Ala na na.
I naxa mixi ɲaaxi tɔɔnɛ hali a xa fe birin sɔɔnɛyaxi.
I naxa xɔnɔ, i i bɔɲɛ magoro.
Na tɔɔnɛ lu na, a mu fee sɔɔnɛyama i bɛ.
Ala fama mixi ɲaaxie raɲɔnde,
kɔnɔ naxee e xaxili tixi Ala ra,
e fama yi bɔxi sɔtɔde kɛ ra.
A mu buma mixi ɲaaxie xa lɔɛ duniɲa ma.
E mu toma dɛdɛ.
Naxee bɔɲɛe magoroxi,
e tan nan fama yi bɔxi sɔtɔde kɛ ra, e lu bɔɲɛsa kui.
Tinxintare tinxintɔɛ yanfama, a xɔnɔ a ma.
Kɔnɔ Marigi yelema na mixi ɲaaxi ma,
barima a a kolon a fama naxan sɔtɔde.
Mixi ɲaaxie santidɛgɛma bama a tɛɛ i,
e xali fan suxu,
alako e xa misikiinɛ nun setare tɔɔrɔ,
e xa tinxintɔɛ kɔn naxaba.
Kɔnɔ e tan nan fama faxade e yɛtɛ xa santidɛgɛma saabui ra.
E xa xalie fama girade.
Se xuri naxan na tinxintɔɛ yi ra,
a fisa mixi ɲaaxie xa bannaya bɛ,
barima Alatala e sɛnbɛ kanama nɛ,
a fa tinxintɔɛ mali.
Alatala ɲɛngi saxi mixi fanyi xɔn.
E kɛ buma nɛ abadan.
E mu yaagima tɔɔrɛ tɛmui, e lugama nɛ kaamɛ waxati.
Kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxie faxama nɛ.
Alatala yaxuie luma nɛ alɔ fiili,
naxan sɛxɛ lisima, a fa gan.
Mixi ɲaaxi doni tongoma nɛ, kɔnɔ e mu a fima.
Mixi fanyi tan mixie kima a xa fonisireya kui.
Alatala xa barakatɔɛe yi bɔxi sɔtɔma nɛ kɛ ra,
kɔnɔ Ala naxan dankama, na kanyi fama halakide.
Naxan ɲɛrɛ ki rafan Alatala ma,
a na kanyi malima nɛ a xa duniɲɛigiri kui.
Hali a sa dinkon, a mu birama,
barima a bɛlɛxɛ na Alatala yi ra.
Kabi n dimɛdi tɛmui, han n xɛmɔxi ra,
n mu tinxintɔɛ keren toxi Ala naxan nabɛɲinxi,
naxan xa die taami makulama.
Tinxintɔɛ ki tima, a mixie donima.
A xa die barakɛ sɔtɔma nɛ.
I xa fe kobi lu na, i xa fe fanyi raba.
Na kui i simaya xɔnkuye sɔtɔma nɛ.
Sɛriyɛ rafan Alatala ma.
A mu a xa hinnɛntee rabɛɲinma.
A e kantama nɛ abadan.
Kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxie bɔnsɔɛ fama nɛ halakide.
Tinxintɔɛe fama nɛ yi bɔxi sɔtɔde kɛ ra, e lu be abadan.
Tinxintɔɛ lɔnni nan masenma,
sɛriyɛ nan minima a dɛ kui.
A Marigi Ala xa sɛriyɛ na a bɔɲɛ kui,
a mu birama kira xɔn.
Mixi ɲaaxi tinxintɔɛ yanfama, a xa a faxa.
Kɔnɔ Alatala mu tinxintɔɛ luma a yaxuie sagoe.
A mu tinma e xa a tɔɔɲɛgɛ kiiti tɛmui.
I xaxili ti Alatala ra, a xa kira suxu,
alako a xa i rakeli, i xa yi bɔxi sɔtɔ kɛ ra.
Na tɛmui i mixi ɲaaxie toma nɛ e halakixi.
Tɛmui dangixi n bara sɛnbɛma ɲaaxi nde to.
A xungbo alɔ wuri tofanyi.
Kɔnɔ n to dangi a yire a firin nde,
n naxa a li a xa fe xuben.
N naxa a fen, kɔnɔ n mu a to.
I xa mixi fanyi nan mato, tinxintɔɛ nan igbɛ.
Na mixi mɔɔli findima barakatɔɛ nan na.
Kɔnɔ yunubitɔɛe tan fama nɛ sɔntɔde,
e bɔnsɔɛ birin fa halaki.
Alatala tinxintɔɛe rakisima nɛ,
a findi e xa makantama ra e xa tɔɔrɛ kui.
A e malima nɛ, a e ratanga.
A e ratanga mixi ɲaaxie ma, a e rakisi,
barima e yigiyaxi a tan nan ma.
